{{Quote|For desert,[sic] I have arranged an assortment of Cavaellin spiced creams.|A [[434-FPC Personal Chef Droid]]|<ref name="GFT" />}}
'''Cavaellin Creams''', also called '''Cavaellin spiced creams''',<ref name="GFT" /> were delicious spiced candies<ref name="SWG" /> from the [[Cavaell system/Legends|Cavaell system]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> They were made from [[carbosyrup]], [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]], and [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="SWG" /> Cavaellin spiced creams were often served as a dessert.<ref name="GFT" />
